summary: Frontend-only testing completed for premium design updates on Products, Solutions, and About pages. All hero sections correctly display UPPERCASE headings with gradient cyan styling. Products page (90 products), Solutions page (11 solution cards), and About page (4 stat cards) all load and display correctly.

features_tested.feature: Products page hero shows 'LED DISPLAY PRODUCTS' in uppercase with gradient cyan
features_tested.details: Hero displays 'LED DISPLAY' + 'PRODUCTS' with gradient cyan styling on PRODUCTS. Title uses bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-cyan-200

features_tested.feature: Products page category filters and product grid display correctly
features_tested.details: 90 products displayed. Category filters (COB MicroLED, Outdoor, etc.) are clickable and filter products correctly. COB MicroLED shows 4 products.
Search input filters products dynamically. Searching 'outdoor' reduced results from 90 to 15 products.

features_tested.feature: Solutions page hero shows 'LED DISPLAY SOLUTIONS' in uppercase with gradient cyan
features_tested.details: Hero displays 'LED DISPLAY' + 'SOLUTIONS' with gradient cyan styling matching homepage premium design.

features_tested.feature: Solutions page displays all 11 solution cards with icons and images
features_tested.details: All 11 solution cards verified: retail, corporate, outdoor, events, creative, traffic, immersive, transparent, healthcare, education, sports. Each has icon, title, description, and tags.

features_tested.feature: About page hero shows 'ENGINEERING VISUAL EXCELLENCE' in uppercase with gradient cyan
features_tested.details: Hero displays 'ENGINEERING' + 'VISUAL EXCELLENCE' with gradient cyan styling on second line.

features_tested.feature: About page stats section displays 4 stat cards (2005, UAE, 1500+, 24/7)
features_tested.details: All 4 stat cards visible with icons: 2005 (Established), UAE (Headquartered), 1500+ (Screens Installed), 24/7 (Support). All have gradient cyan values.

features_tested.feature: Navigation works correctly between all three pages
features_tested.details: Direct navigation to /products, /solutions, /about all work correctly. Solution card clicks navigate to detail pages (/solutions/retail).

critical_code_review_comments: Hero sections are well-implemented with consistent UPPERCASE styling and gradient cyan text
Products.js, Solutions.js, and About.js all follow the same premium design pattern
data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Minimal description text centered beneath headings matches homepage style
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium design updates tested and verified. All three pages (Products, Solutions, About) have UPPERCASE hero headings with gradient cyan styling. Products has 90 items, Solutions has 11 cards, About has 4 stat cards (2005, UAE, 1500+, 24/7).
